purpose: Track how each story area can become a complete 78-card tarot deck while preserving MythCards card identity.

closed_city.tracker_scope_note: This tracker began with Closed City but is currently acting as the Russian tarot master planning area until separate 26-card trackers are created for Closed City, Far North, and Winter Front / Army Era.
closed_city.deck_style: Soviet occult-science tarot built from reactor rooms, signal arrays, dream monitors, military containment, hidden patronage, redacted evidence, and the first physical cards.

suit_style.Wands: signal rods, warning lights, authority badges, reactor flame
suit_style.Cups: dream monitors, sleep-lab vessels, signal water, intimate confessions
suit_style.Swords: containment blades, redacted files, command orders, diagnostic truth
suit_style.Pentacles: reactor parts, keys, helmets, notebooks, industrial relics

russian_sub_areas.role: 1980s-era science and industrial setting with nuclear power, leaks, cosmonaut programs, remote viewing, dream work, and the first convergence incident.
Remote northern Russia with survival folklore, old rites, aurora/ice mysticism, animal power, healing, the tiger, gymnast, Frost Seer, and Nadia Belaya.
russian_sub_areas.note: Nadia Belaya belongs to this sub-area even though she is temporarily tracked in the Russian tarot mapping as The Star.

russian_sub_areas.role: World War II-era and older army setting with command, snipers, engineers, battlefield endurance, sacrifice, and national mythic memory.

sub_area_deck_model.tarot_deck_note: A complete Russian physical tarot deck can be built from three 26-card Russian sub-areas, giving 78 MythCards/tarot representatives without forcing Closed City alone to fill every tarot archetype.

relics: Cosmonaut Helmet With A Second Shadow

original_russian_prototype_cards.note: These earlier prototype cards remain part of the planning inventory. Some have been expanded or replaced by richer review-draft versions; Far North and Winter Front cards should eventually move into their own 26-card sub-area trackers.

events: The Knives Mark A False Road
The Circus Performs The Old Rite
far_north_story_draft_cards.status_note: These are Far North story/card drafts. Some are existing prototype cards to expand; others are new cards created from the current narrative pass.

characters: Rifle Company Soldier / Private Stepan Kuznetsov
winter_front_story_draft_cards.status_note: These are Winter Front / Army Era story/card drafts. The sub-area is now framed as a World War II-era winter front on the future Closed City site, with enemy occult cache material, an old ritual cabin, iron rings that eventually connect to the Deep North Circus, future Closed City visions, and a simultaneous Far North meteor event.

narrative_support_cards.name: Colonel Viktor Semyonov
narrative_support_cards.role: Promoted to Closed City rare Leader. He does not replace the primary regular Leader card, Irina Vasilievna Karpova; he occupies one of the two rare Closed City character slots.

cross_sub_area_tarot_placeholders.name: Nadia Belaya
cross_sub_area_tarot_placeholders.note: Keep her mapped in the Russian tarot plan, but do not count her as a Closed City character.

winter_front_event_art_audit.art_note: Revised art keeps four frozen upright bayonet-rifles while adding the Four of Swords restoration/contemplation layer: one side survives by resting and restoring life, while the other tries to rush through a winter soldiers interpret as divine or occult intervention.
Remapped from Five of Pentacles to avoid duplicating Far North's survivor event; art shows Volkov ordering exhausted soldiers into contested snow.
Remapped from Seven of Cups to avoid duplicating the cache relic; art centers chained temptation and a smoke-shadow Devil shape.

Moonlit cabin discovery with misleading tracks, wrong moon reflection, chalk geometry, and the iron rings in their wartime ritual origin. V2 corrects the rings to match the Far North Circus Convergence Rings relic lineage.

Remapped from Eight of Wands to Wheel of Fortune after the signal art fought the exact count. The approved art shows Elena Morozova, preserving her High Priestess identity, appearing through a fate-like radio wheel and looking directly at the player/card-holder.
Remapped from Six of Swords to avoid duplicating the Frozen T-34; art shows the rings leaving on a sled while exactly eight cups remain behind.
Remapped from The Tower to protect the Closed City Incident's Tower identity; art frames the future facility as nightmare and shell shock.
Remapped from The Star because Nadia Belaya owns that archetype. Page of Cups centers Marya Zima's battered thaw cup receiving an impossible northern omen while radios and compasses react behind her.
Ilya carries wounded Stepan and an enemy relic case through smoke, with a subtle lion-like smoke shape for controlled strength.

current_mappings.reason: The ordinary worker steps through sealed routes first, not because he is chosen by doctrine, but because someone must move.
Orlov stands at the conversion point where data, symbol, reactor force, and dream become usable power.
Elena guards the threshold between measured science and hidden dream knowledge.
Karpova is wealth, patronage, appetite, comfort, and control made politically fertile.

current_mappings.set_count_role: Closed City rare character slot: extra Leader for the Russian set. Does not replace Irina Vasilievna Karpova as the regular Closed City Leader.
current_mappings.reason: Semyonov is visible order, military containment, and the architecture of command.
Keep open for now. The best fit may be a future doctrine, institution, containment protocol, or sanctioned occult-science card rather than an existing character.
The event centers choice, desire, divided loyalty, and the emotional wound between Elena, Orlov, Yuri, and the breach.
VERA-7 is directed movement through impossible corridors and disciplined transport under pressure.
Yuri's strength is not only armor; it is restraint under desire, fear, and containment duty.
Keep open for now. Zoya has some Hermit signal-carrier qualities, but her core energy may fit Moon, Devil, Cups, or another dream/desire archetype better.
Reality turns suddenly and briefly, changing paths, fate, and position.
Keep open for now. Redacted Incident Tape and Anya Lebedev are possible candidates, but Justice should represent evidence, truth, and accountability rather than official state law.

Pavel is suspended between worlds after the Closed City incident: alive but displaced, pulled north by a relic and desire he does not yet understand. His journey is surrender, altered perspective, and the sacrifice of his old life.
Keep open for now. Elena Missing In The Signal and Closed City Incident are already stronger as The Lovers and The Tower; Death should wait for a more exact irreversible-transformation card.

current_mappings.set_count_role: Closed City rare character slot: extra Specialist for the Russian set.
current_mappings.reason: Anya turns Temperance into controlled passage between systems: physical locks, analog signal routing, occult timing, dream geometry, and convergence travel mixed precisely enough to create Pavel's seventeen-second escape.
current_mappings.art_note: Temperance was checked open in the Russian tarot tracker before assignment. Art should show Anya balancing two signals, two vessels, or two realities inside a sealed Closed City threshold, with analog relay cabinets, warning lamps, condensation, and an impossible corridor opening toward aurora-lit snow.

current_mappings.reason: The key turns access, permission, desire, and dependence into a beautiful trap. It represents power that opens doors while binding people to Karpova's system.
The reactor opening inward is the area's Tower: catastrophic revelation, collapse of false structure, and divine/occult rupture.

current_mappings.set_count_role: Far North character; temporarily tracked in the Russian tarot plan and should not be counted as a Closed City character.
current_mappings.reason: Nadia Belaya is the Far North Mystic healer whose innocent mercy becomes proof that the breach does not only take; she saves someone after convergence exposure and gives the Russian arc its living image of hope.

candidate_concept.narrative_role: A northern healer who understands old cold-water rites, survival medicine, and the spiritual cost of keeping someone alive after convergence exposure.
candidate_concept.tarot_fit: The Star as healing after catastrophe, a living sign that the Russian arc contains mercy as well as secrecy and containment.
catch_phrases: I do not ask the wound what it deserves.
I listen for the light still breathing under the ice.
Come back. The dark has held you long enough.

current_mappings.reason: Zoya embodies the Closed City's dream-shadow: desire, illusion, psychic distortion, hidden memory, and the dangerous pull of what Orlov thinks he understands.
current_mappings.art_note: Corrected variant keeps the Closed City lab functional and humid rather than literally flooded; Moon symbolism comes from fogged glass, CRT crescents, lunar light, reflections, and hidden observer silhouettes.

current_mappings.reason: A terrible inner sun gives power at a cost and exposes the body's vulnerability to light.
The old impact site answers the new convergence: buried forces wake, old memories rise, and the land is called back into consequence.
current_mappings.art_note: Event art centers the cracked meteor hollow, black glass fragments, tiny witnesses, and an aurora shaped like a natural calling horn with ghostly memory-figures rising through it.

current_mappings.reason: The first physical MythCards artifact turns the convergence from dream and machinery into a complete object that can pass between worlds; it closes the first Closed City loop and opens the larger game reality.

Galina turns the Closed City hospital ward into the first vessel of mercy after the reactor breach. Ace of Cups fits triage, compassion, the first protected survivor, and an emotional opening inside a system trying to seal every wound away as evidence.
current_mappings.art_note: Ace of Cups was checked as unused in the Russian tarot tracker before assignment. The card should feel medical, intimate, and occult-scientific: a night ward, enamel basin, IV glass, iodine, black frost, and the suggestion that mercy itself is becoming a breach.

current_mappings.reason: A small physical relic becomes the seed of material and mystical control.
current_mappings.art_note: Corrected variant keeps the Chintamani fragment sealed inside the evidence container, with the tag and cord attached outside the latch/seal rather than passing through the glass.

current_mappings.reason: The sealed reactor shard turns material power into a balancing act: useful danger, Leak exposure, and unstable advantage held under pressure.
Three subjects, three monitors, and the lab team become one working occult-science structure: specialized craft, collaboration, and systems-thinking turning into contamination.
The notebook turns discovery into guarded possession: classified knowledge sealed away, owned, feared, and used to extend the reach of those who control it.
Semyonov's order turns hardship into institutional exclusion: witnesses are locked out of aid, truth, and resources while the state controls who is allowed inside the warmth of certainty.

current_mappings.set_count_role: Winter Front rare character slot: extra Hero for the Russian set.
current_mappings.reason: Alexei turns victory into a burden. The enemy occult cache chooses him as the courier of a black-and-gold Atlantean standard, so soldiers see triumph while the story reveals convergence obligation.
current_mappings.art_note: Rare Hero art shows Alexei with the black-and-gold Atlantean standard, Marya Zima as the female witness, and cross-area reflections tying pre-flood Atlantis, future Closed City, and the Far North meteor.

current_mappings.reason: Keep open for a Closed City card more directly about rationed resources, controlled aid, debt, patronage, or unequal distribution of material support.
The tape is young, dangerous evidence: surveillance, investigation, nervous truth, and a message that changes when watched. It fits Page of Swords better than a material exchange card.
The array's impossible turn is the first message already in motion: sudden signal, directional force, acceleration, and communication crossing distance before anyone understands it.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Cosmonaut Helmet With A Second Shadow
current_mappings.reason: The recovered helmet is nightmare evidence: sleepless dread, returned trauma, guilt, and proof that something came back in the reflection.
The aurora becomes the first active ignition of Far North mythic power: a new force entering the world through light, motion, and old northern rites.
current_mappings.art_note: Event art uses one dominant vertical aurora column as a living wand/door, with snow, track lines, and black meteor glass reacting at the base while Buran remains a small answering presence.

current_mappings.reason: Mila is youthful movement, risk, performance, curiosity, and dangerous beauty. Her acrobatics are forgotten sky rites preserved as circus art.

Tomas represents the ordinary labor that lets the Far North survive: cutting fuel, repairing boundary posts, hauling supplies, keeping sled routes visible, and doing patient work long before anyone knows whether the work will be enough.
current_mappings.art_note: Seven of Pentacles was checked open in the Russian tarot tracker before assignment. Art should show a rugged village laborer with stacked firewood, sled runners, repaired boundary posts, and exactly seven visible cut log ends, carved post marks, or pentacle-like wood rounds as the tarot cue.

current_mappings.reason: Buran carries pounce, speed, instinct, animal force, and convergence momentum through the Far North.

current_mappings.set_count_role: Far North rare character slot: extra Mount for the Russian set.
current_mappings.reason: Belorog gives the Far North a rare Mount based on spiritual rescue, emotional truth, and convergence passage. Knight of Cups fits a mount that carries wounded or surrendered travellers through aurora-water thresholds rather than charging through danger like Buran.
current_mappings.art_note: Knight of Cups was checked open in the Russian tarot tracker before assignment. Art should show a pale aurora-lit reindeer with luminous antlers, practical northern harness, red thread and charms, frozen river reflections, and a humble cup or bowl motif tied to spiritual passage.

current_mappings.reason: The Bogatyr Champion is the Winter Front's mythic heroic fire: oath, charisma, morale, protection, and the dangerous beauty of sacrifice under impossible cold.

Anya makes Winter Front's second Common civilian rather than military. Six of Pentacles fits rationing, uneven mercy, shared bread, scarce supplies, and the survival economy of evacuation roads under wartime command pressure.
current_mappings.art_note: Card art shows Anya at a frozen evacuation road with a civilian sled, shared bread, a cracked icon with subtle reactor-red reflection, exactly six visible ration tokens, and a half-buried iron ring hinting at the later Deep North Circus connection. Six of Pentacles was checked open before assignment.

current_mappings.set_count_role: Winter Front rare character slot: extra Warrior for the Russian set.
current_mappings.reason: Darya turns Knight of Swords into close-range devotional momentum: decisive charge, bayonet-as-sword, winter wind, and the dangerous faith to cross enemy ritual lines before fear can make a doctrine out of them.
current_mappings.art_note: Knight of Swords was checked open in the Russian tarot tracker before assignment. Art should show a fierce female Winter Front close-combat warrior with rifle and fixed bayonet, prayer cloth, diagonal snow/smoke motion, and occult trench lines breaking underfoot.

current_mappings.reason: Volkov turns command into cold judgment: lives become entries on a map, and sacrifice becomes a calculation he believes he alone is fit to make.
current_mappings.art_note: Remapped from The Emperor so Colonel Viktor Semyonov can own the Emperor archetype. King of Swords centers Volkov's strategic cruelty, silver pointer-as-sword, red command sash, casualty lists, and soldiers sent into lethal snow.

current_mappings.reason: The map is ambition made material: one path holds the current battlefield, while the other leaves home, mercy, and ordinary command for occult certainty.
current_mappings.art_note: Approved relic art shows two black field rods over a red-stained command map, with Volkov's family/home traces and a face-down icon revealing the personal cost of choosing the impossible route.

current_mappings.reason: The Horizon Lens turns Three of Wands into foresight across fronts: Winter Front smoke, Far North meteor light, and future Closed City corridors seen together through one cracked field lens.
current_mappings.art_note: Approved revision zooms into the cracked brass lens so the three visions appear only inside the glass, while the outside trench remains grounded and normal.

current_mappings.reason: The Hearthstone Antler Crown gives the Far North village its sacred foundation: celebration, home, survival, and belonging around an ancient relic that predates the settlement.
current_mappings.art_note: Approved relic art shows the village celebration gathered around the ancient antler-and-stone relic, with four decorated posts forming the Four of Wands structure.

current_mappings.reason: The cup is grief and mercy rather than balance: three losses on the table, two vessels of remaining warmth, and one life that can still be bargained back from the cold.
current_mappings.art_note: Remapped from Temperance so Marya Zima keeps Temperance as a character. Approved relic art shows the glowing thaw cup in a frozen aid station with three fallen vessels and one standing background cup.

current_mappings.reason: The icon is wounded faith: sacred protection revealed through piercing, grief, sacrifice, and the miraculous white-bird omen around Darya.
current_mappings.art_note: Remapped from The Hierophant so Anastasia Lebedeva can keep formal faith authority. Approved relic art shows a cracked field icon crossed by three bayonet/sword wounds with rare white birds outside.

current_mappings.reason: The mirror is a physical relic Pavel carries without understanding: hidden reflection, attraction, memory, spiritual invitation, and a material lesson from the Far North path.
current_mappings.art_note: Remapped from Page of Cups to Page of Pentacles so Meteor Contact To The North can own the cup-message archetype. Corrected variant increases the mirror scale to match Pavel's character artwork, making it a large hand-held disc rather than a small pendant.

current_mappings.reason: Pavel and Mila's first meaningful exchange turns attraction into relationship while the Sky-Hide Mirror responds between them.
current_mappings.art_note: V3 preserves Pavel and Mila sharing exactly two humble metal vodka cups in the tent light, keeps the established Sky-Hide Mirror looped frame, and makes the mirror feel more naturally grounded in the scene.

current_mappings.reason: The village survives by refusing the offered vision: doors close, radios shut off, and wonder is rejected because the people remember its cost.
current_mappings.art_note: V2 shows collective village refusal through shutters closing, a radio being covered, charms turned inward, children guided away from windows, Pavel outside the social circle, and exactly four covered or overturned vessels in the foreground. The aurora is abstract rather than a literal cup.

current_mappings.reason: The circus carries memory, nostalgia, childhood wonder, old longing, and the past returning as performance under frost and lantern light.
current_mappings.art_note: V2 corrects the visual count to exactly six cup-lanterns on one foreground crate and simplifies the circus-arrival tableau while keeping children drawn forward, elders uneasy, village houses, canvas tents, and aurora overhead.

current_mappings.reason: Aksinya Morozova reads emotional and spiritual truth through cold silence, meltwater, breath, and frost. She is the Far North's watcher-Queen of Cups: present at the edge of the pattern, compassionate toward suffering but careful with intervention, influencing through signs and withheld answers rather than direct confrontation.
current_mappings.art_note: V4 keeps the clear scrying reflection and hidden frost influence from v3 while improving continuity with Nadia Belaya's approved artwork: hooded off-white robe, red embroidery, brown braid, pendant, and warm Star-like healing light as she saves Pavel.

current_mappings.reason: Yakov Antonov represents survival craft, repeated work, barricades, field repair, and practical mastery under brutal winter-war conditions.

The Frozen T-34 is the Winter Front's haunted mechanical passage: soldiers and wounded carried across lethal ground by armor, frost, and something that may no longer belong only to the living. Six of Swords preserves Buran's Far North Chariot role while making the tank about grim transport rather than triumphant charge.
current_mappings.art_note: Mount art uses the Frozen T-34 as a haunted ferry across the killing field, with wounded soldiers on the armor, exactly six sword-like bayonet markers lining the passage, and reactor-red convergence glow under the ice. It intentionally avoids Chariot charge language because Far North already uses that archetype.

current_mappings.reason: Vera begins as the village's spear-bearing warrior and grows into its visible leader. Queen of Wands fits her fierce earned authority, protective charisma, animal bond with Buran, and ability to stand between the village and the meteor-born unknown.
current_mappings.art_note: V3 keeps the younger, more vital Queen of Wands direction from v2 while adding red ribbons in Vera's hair and a practical riding harness on Buran to show their mount/leader relationship.

current_mappings.set_role: Approved rare relic for the Far North sub-area
current_mappings.reason: The Sakha/Yakut world-tree relic is the Far North's rare mythic relic and cosmological axis between upper, middle, and lower worlds. Its tarot mapping can remain The World for the Far North sub-area, with final deck arbitration later if the full Russian physical tarot deck needs The World reserved for The First Card Appears.
Vera's meteor-glass spear gives the Far North a direct protective relic: clarity, separation, and decisive boundary-cutting against false aurora light and entity influence.
current_mappings.art_note: Relic art focuses on a practical spear with a jagged black meteor-glass blade, red wraps, iron wire, protective knots, and aurora reflection at the village boundary.

current_mappings.reason: The harness turns Buran and Vera's impossible mounted crossing into disciplined, grounded, survivable work. It carries trust, endurance, protection, and preparation rather than domination.
current_mappings.art_note: Relic art keeps the harness consistent with Buran and Vera's established imagery: rugged dark leather, iron rings, red cords, boundary charms, tiger pawprints, Vera's boot tracks, and aurora-lit village posts.

current_mappings.reason: The circus rings turn Two of Pentacles into convergence balancing: practical performance hardware that keeps two unstable forces in motion long enough for the Old Rite to hold.
current_mappings.art_note: Relic art shows exactly two dominant old iron circus rings with worn rope, red thread, leather wraps, subtle Atlantean etching, and Old Rite floor geometry inside the Deep North Circus tent.

current_mappings.reason: The village's original meteor-glass lantern turns The Hermit into pathfinding wisdom: a single true light that reveals safe trails, intact boundaries, and false aurora guidance.
current_mappings.art_note: Relic art centers one old handmade lantern with blackened iron, scratched glass, red thread, boundary charms, a black meteor-glass shard, and warm true light against aurora-lit snow.

current_mappings.reason: Oleg is the Far North's living wall: strength, speed hidden inside mass, cold resistance, endurance after injury, and the stubborn will to hold a boundary when the village needs time to survive.
current_mappings.art_note: Corrected card art uses jet-black hair and beard for Oleg, and exactly nine vertical boundary stakes/poles to make the Nine of Wands mapping explicit.

current_mappings.reason: Dmitri turns Seven of Swords into circus misdirection, blade skill, hidden knowledge, secret routes, and the ambiguous ethics of deception used to protect people from truths that may harm them.
current_mappings.art_note: V3 keeps Dmitri's longer dark hair and deep teal/emerald costume accents while improving the target-board knives with darker entry points, contact shadows, and visible wood damage so the blades read as embedded.

current_mappings.reason: Pavel is found outside the warmth and certainty of the world he knew, injured in the snow after an impossible displacement. Nadia's rescue turns Five of Pentacles toward mercy in exile: suffering, exposure, and the hand that reaches someone before the cold takes them.
current_mappings.art_note: Event art keeps Nadia and Pavel continuity while distinguishing itself from Nadia's character card through wider composition, Pavel's exposure, the visible Sky-Hide Mirror, distant shelter lights, and the huge aurora wound overhead.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: The Knives Mark A False Road
current_mappings.reason: Dmitri's knife pattern becomes a conflict of interpretation: warning, deception, rivalry, protection, and the cost of winning by letting someone believe the wrong story.
current_mappings.art_note: Event art centers Dmitri in the Deep North Circus tent with five dominant embedded blades on the target board, Pavel and Mila secondary in the snowy background, and the warning framed as both performance and deception.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: The Circus Performs The Old Rite
current_mappings.reason: The circus act reveals hidden craft and collaboration: acrobatics, knives, rigging, lanterns, ropes, music, and embodied memory forming an extremely old Atlantean convergence rite disguised as entertainment.
current_mappings.art_note: V2 shows Mila, Dmitri, and Oleg forming three centers of craft inside the tent, with a witnessing crowd and rope/lantern/floor geometry suggesting three interlocked rings around a vertical convergence mark. Dmitri and Oleg read as collaborators in the rite rather than opponents.

current_mappings.reason: Buran and Vera turn animal force and earned authority into controlled motion through danger, breaking the failing boundary by driving straight through the breach.
current_mappings.art_note: Event art expresses The Chariot through Vera riding Buran at speed through opposing aurora and snow forces, with the village behind them, the breach ahead, and no literal wheeled chariot.

flood_survivors.deck_style: Drowned Atlantean and Egyptian mystery tarot built from black water, ley stones, sealed vaults, memory rites, the Emerald Tablet, the Black Sarcophagus, hidden bloodlines, angelic judgment, and forbidden survivor truth.

suit_style.Wands: ley-staffs, living causeways, royal command, serpent routes
suit_style.Cups: black water, memory bowls, burial rites, drowned love
suit_style.Swords: tomb oaths, erased names, judgment, guarded truth
suit_style.Pentacles: basalt stones, tablets, sarcophagi, vault instruments, pearls

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Stone-Line Laborer / Menka of the Lower Causeway
current_mappings.reason: Menka is the ordinary worker who opens forbidden routes toward an unknown future.
The Emerald Tablet is the preserved formula by which above and below, Atlantis and Egypt, symbol and matter reflect one another.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Thalassa-Nekh, Vessel of the Drowned Seraph
current_mappings.reason: She is hidden spiritual knowledge embodied, and not all of that knowledge is human.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Queen Meret-Anu, Keeper of the Buried Tide
current_mappings.reason: She is preservation, bloodline, sovereignty, and controlled fertility after catastrophe.
Ahesu turns will, rider, and route into motion through living stone and black water.
Naia's ferocity is bound to restraint, oath, grief, and the courage to face the sealed dead.
He carries a lonely inner light made from memories no society wants to face.
The entity delivers judgment beyond royal editing or survivor convenience.
The sarcophagus is death, transformation, forbidden remains, and the unsealing of what must change.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: The Name Was Cut From Stone
current_mappings.reason: A false monument breaks when the erased name returns.
The reflecting water reveals hidden fear, buried memory, and unstable truth.
The survivors carry the old world into the next one, completing one cycle and beginning another.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Iset-Nara, Architect of the Hidden Vault
current_mappings.reason: She represents sacred craft, design, collaboration, and stonework as hidden knowledge.
A first stirring of living route-energy and dangerous forward motion.

next_steps: Decide whether a game card can appear in both the playable game set and a physical tarot deck, or whether tarot deck cards are separate premium art variants.
Create one 26-card tracker per sub-area as the art catalog grows, starting with Russian Closed City, Far North, and Winter Front / Army Era.
Before inventing a new tarot-specific card, check the defined card inventory for unmapped original prototype cards and review-draft cards.
Audit existing Closed City, Far North, Winter Front, and Flood Survivor artwork against the proposed tarot mappings.
Fill missing Major Arcana first, then Minor Arcana suit by suit.
When generating new art, include the tarot archetype in the art prompt as a compositional constraint.
